notes.title: Minimum System Requirements for 'Echo' Game Updated
notes.content:
Due to some players reporting issues with game slowness and extended loading times, we have updated the minimum system requirements. Since "Echo" does not run on the RPG Maker engine, please use an operating system of Windows 8.1 or higher to ensure smooth gameplay. Older operating systems will not be supported, and we apologize for any inconvenience.

[previewyoutube=9JbM-us2WVY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: "Echo" - Project 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31152366/5e61d64481e6bbd41bfbc320e8b3252334586d19.jpg[/img]

[h2]"Echo" - Project 2[/h2]
“Project 2” is an update provided by the author for free after the second playthrough to thank players for their support and love. It allows players to delve deeper into the truth behind the story from a second perspective without affecting the main storyline. Details that may have been overlooked during the first playthrough may be important clues. The story ranges to the ending, and it is expected to be fully updated before August.

The reason it is called “Project 2” is not only because it is related to the second playthrough, but also because the game version will be updated to 2.0.0 tomorrow. At the same time, June 2nd is also the half-year anniversary of the game’s official release. The second Lin that appeared in the story will also reveal some of her secrets in future updates. (The author also has a special connection with the number 2). 

In conjunction with the release of “Project 2”, there will be a limited-time 20% off discount. Players who have not played the game can download a free trial version that allows for over 2 hours of gameplay. Due to limited development time for 2 people, “Project 2” is planned to be updated in stages for free. Subsequent updates will be announced, so please continue to follow and support us. Thank you very much.

notes.title: "Echo" will be launched EARLY ACCESS on 10/22 (GMT+8)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31152366/3287f155b977b681f9e34c856bfa1375739be813.png[/img]
[h3]Hello everyone, we are glad to tell you that
"Echo" will be launched Steam EARLY ACCESS on 10/22 (GMT+8).[/h3]

In order to allow more players to experience and transfer 
Clear data, we have set the prologue as a free version.
The full version of Echo is sold in DLC.
The game key of full version will be given to the sponsors of Backers and Kickstarter.
The physical goods will be sent after the quality of the digital version is confirmed to be stable.
Please forgive us. If you have any questions, please feel free to leave your comments.

Please remember to follow us and add the game to your wish list!
Fanpage: [url=https://www.facebook.com/Echo2010.ourvoice/]https://www.facebook.com/Echo2010.ourvoice/[/url]
Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/echo_ourvoice]https://twitter.com/echo_ourvoice[/url]

[h2][b]Why Early Access?[/b][/h2]
Early Access allows players to contribute by giving valuable
feedback that we can then use to improve the game.
We are a small team of two, so this will help us immensely. 
We want this game to be as perfect as possible!

[h2][b]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/b][/h2]
Approximately 2-3 months.
We will keep you updated if there are any changes.

[h2][b]How is the full version different from the Early Access version?[/b][/h2]
The full version will implement the improvements
suggested by players like you during Early Access.
You can expect a better overall gaming experience.

[h2][b]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/b][/h2]
The core game experience is complete.
Currently we are evaluating parts of the game for proper balance
and to fix any bugs or glitches.

[h2][b]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/b][/h2]
The price will not change much after the end of Early Access phase.

[h2][b]How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?[/b][/h2]
We are in need of valuable feedback from our players.
Feel free to leave your feedback on the Steam forums.
You are also welcome to post your fanart.
Although we are busy completing the game we will do our best to 
acknowledge every player's comments.

[h3][Adventurer companion request][/h3]
Lin encountered some obstacles while exploring the Constructed Forest.
It is hoped that guild adventurers will investigate together.

[b][list]
[*]Event name:
Lin's Adventurer Companion Commission
[*]Event time:
From now to 2022/03/31 23:59
[*]Submission format:
Please [url=https://lihi1.cc/BbvcN]download[/url] 00_Template.png for reference, 
and return the completed bitmap in this form.

notes.title: Echo Demo Ver2.20 Release! 2019/02/02
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31152366/710f05260a10638345386dcc47a55c8536ef2eca.png[/img]

2019/02/02 Ver2.20
​[New Features]
1. Add title screen operation guide.
2. First appearance of the boss name.
3. Rechallenge boss's death animation.
4. Status page switches between growing and ungrown values.
5. Spanish language. (Between funding and time, the Full version does not necessarily have to.)
6. Autosave system.
​[Fixes]
1. Opening movie can't play.
2. Cure skills can resurrect characters.
3. The backup teammate levelup animation will show in front of the menu.
[Adjustments]
1. The ole movement path in story.
2. Enemy's death animation performance.
3. When character critical, the screen will not shake.
4. Solved the puzzle will some reward, skipping without reward but without negative effects.
5. The boss's name of the challenge system be display.
6. Some keyboard buttons can be set as function buttons.
7. Jump decision adjustment.
8. Dialogue text layout adjustment.
9. Select text move to the center.
10. Save and Load page operation adjustment.

Full Version is continue on development.
Long time no update Demo.
There have many updates this time,
Please give more improve or advise.
Thank you! 😃

notes.title: Echo Demo Ver2.12 Release! 2018/07/01
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31152366/15ce23eae626a846650b006ff4cbc17adb248414.png[/img]

[Fixes]
1. Fonts error in growing system.
2. Mission description incomplete.
3. English tutorial display bug.
4. A bug that causes description error after changing game language.
5. Hitting cancel will leave system page instead of leaving current page.
6. Mini-game hitbox error.
7. Map bugs in Constructed Mansion.
8. Dying characters' HP will become 1 when changing their equipments.
9. Fix a bug that causes players able to control characters in some scenes.
10. Enemy AI error after leaving challenge mode.
11. Unable to cast a spell when hoding arrow keys.
12. Errors in notebook.
13. Backup members' AP could not restore to full.
14. The equipment will drop repeatedly.
[[Adjustments]
1. Item cooldowns are now 0.3 seconds.
2. Adds tablets in some areas.
3. Level up animation of backup members are now on bottom right.
4. Targets of fast healing and clean healing adjustments.
5. Flame Clusters and Wolf Flash now have different ways to cast.
6. Some adjustments in growing system.
7. Display adjustments in charging attack and spell casting.

In a blink of an eye, it came to the hot July.
Thanks for the player's feedback, made many adjustments and corrections,
Please let us know if you have any questions. :D

notes.title: Echo Demo Ver2.10 Release! Support gamepad 2018/04/01
notes.content:
2018/04/01 Ver2.10
[New Features]
1. The game is controller supported now.
2. New key setting interface.
3. Bosses will show their abnormal states now.
4. Enemies will keep respawning in hidden maps now.
5. Hints will pop up in some UI section when the party has more than one member.
[Bug Fixes]
1. Fixed a bug that casting ultimates can be interrupted by dodging.
2. Fixed an issue that Incinerate can not be casted normally.
3. Fixed the animation bug after switching from paralyzed characters.
4. Wrong describtion in item gainning.
5. Character levels display error in Note's challenge page.
6. Fix the bug that enemies won't react when getting hit after respawned.
[Adjustments]
1. You can now re-challenge bosses after failling a boss fight.
2. Casting animations of ultimates can be cancelled by pressing cancel key.
3. Skill describtion in English and Japanese.
4. Remove item cooldown, adjustments in healing amount.
5. Adjustments in skill damage, casting time and cooldown.
6. Some adjustments of controller setion in menu.
7. Attack key combined with confirm key, and jump key combined with cancel key.
8. Adjustments in Note's key config.
9. Some changes in Tutorial.
10. Health regenerating speed up.
11. Adjustments in game difficulty.
12. Adjustments in weapons attacking range.
13. Some adjustments in walking.
14. Some adjustments in leaping and jumping.
15. Pressing worng buttons is no longer considered failing in mini games, only missing buttons is considered failing now.
16. The "turn page" hint in notebook is displayed in upper-right corner now.
17. Some adjustments in enemy taking hits.
18. Increase statistic in growing system result.
19. Adjustments in skilltree's display.
20. Map transfer point adjustment.

This time, a lot of changes have been made.
Please download the Ver 2.10 to try some new.
The old save data can be used.
If there have something bug, please tell us.
Thank you!
(Although today is April Fool's Day, we release the version is True!)
